title: Next Generation Sequencing facilitates to identify the differential expression genes of sorted conventional CD8+ T cells and MAIT cells
description: We obtained conventional CD8+T cells and MAIT cells to rperforme next-generation sequencing (NGS). Illumina mRNA-seq sample preparation kit was used to perform paired-end library sequencing with Illumina HiSeq 2000 and sequence analysis was determined using the Illumina data analysis pipeline. Based on the comparison results，we performed the GO and KEGG pathway enrichment analysis. That might suggest the different status of HBV-infected liver from liver surgery(AST<40) and liver transplantation(AST>40). Overall design: Differential gene expression between MAIT cells from different patients
